# dsh-audio-transcribe

Offline audio-to-text for DeepSeek Harness,
plus a floating widget that records whatever the machine

o-to-text for DeepSeek Harness,
plus a floating widget that records whatever the machine is playing.
Everything runs locally: no API key, no upload, no network at transcription time.
> **Windows x64 only.** The recorder is a bundled WASAPI loopback binary.

> **Tested against DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2.** This plugin leans on two APIs the
> upstream harness cu

rrently marks experimental: bundle loading via
> `dsh.bundle.patch`, and index injection through `we

bserver/index-inject`.
> Both have been stable across the 0.2.0-rc line, but a future DSH release ma

y
> change them. If the tools or the widget stop appearing after a DSH upgrade,
> check this first r

ather than assuming the plugin is broken — see
> TROUBLESHOOTING.md.
## Install

entirely, so there is no

thing for pnpm's build-script gate to block and no
network to depend on. Use the absolute path, and

keep the `file:` prefix — a
bare `.\dir` becomes a `link:` symlink, and Node then resolves the plugi

n's
DSH peer packages from the symlink target and fails to find them.

This fetches the sources and installs them through the registry. This plugin has
no `install` / `pos

tinstall` / `prepare` scripts and no native dependencies, so
it should not trip pnpm's build-script

policy. If pnpm does refuse with
`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`, it is naming *some other* package being

pulled in as a
transitive dependency — follow its prompt to allow that package, or use the
`file:` r

the SenseVoice cache t

## What it gives you
### Three model tools
| Tool | Purpose |

| `audio_transcribe` | Turn a WAV file into text with the local SenseVoice model |
| `audio_model` |

Report where the model lives and whether it is intact |
| `audio_model_download` | Fetch the model
(~230 MB) into a directory you choose |
### A recording widget
A draggable pill in the bottom-right of the Web/Desktop GUI:

- **Start / stop** capturing system playback (not the microphone)
- Live timer, and it keeps countin

g while the panel is closed
- **View and change** where recordings are stored
- Lists recent recordi

ngs, and marks the ones that already have a transcript
- **Auto-transcribes** each recording to a `.

ones that already have a transcript
- **Auto-transcribes** each recording to a `.txt` beside the WAV
## Why recording needs a host process

A browser cannot capture what the machine is playing. The widget is therefore a
remote control: the

buttons call host routes under `/dsh-audio`, and the host
spawns `bin/LoopbackCap.exe` (WASAPI loopb
ack, via NAudio) to do the capture.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

No virtual audio cable is required: WASAPI loopback reads the output device
directly, without changi
ng the default device or installing a driver.

### Layout

With **每次录音新建独立文件夹** enabled (the default), every take gets its own
folder so the audio and its tran
script stay together:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Turn the option off and recordings land flat in `<recordDir>`, with the timestamp
moved into the fil

ename (`system-audio-2026-10-21_13-02-11.wav`) so they still do
not collide.
[该节后续省略]
### Why a config file, not the settings service

`settings.mutate()` only persists volatile fields of an active *profile entry*.
This plugin is a bun

dle without its own entry id, so a write through that API is
accepted and then silently dropped — wh

ich is why an early version reset the
chosen directory on every restart. The plugin therefore owns a

small JSON file
and writes it atomically (temp file + rename).

Changing the directory uses DSH's own directory-picker seam rather than a
hand-rolled text box. That

seam exposes a **capability**, not one fixed method
set, because backends differ in interaction sha

am exposes a **capability**, not one fixed method
set, because backends differ in interaction shape:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

So the plugin asks the host which kind it has (`GET /dsh-audio/picker.json`) and
renders accordingly

renders accordingly:
| Capability | Widget behaviour |

| `native` | **选择…** opens the OS chooser; manual paste stays as a secondary option |
| `browse` | n

o tree is drawn; the widget says so and offers manual entry |
| none | the picking button is hidden,
manual entry only |

The last case is deliberate: a composition with no picker backend must hide the
affordance rather th

affordance rather than fail.
## Requirements

| Platform | Windows x64 |
| Runtime | reuses the sherpa-onnx build shipped with DSH Desktop 0.2.x |

| .NET | built against the in-box .NET Framework 4.x |
| Recorder | `bin/LoopbackCap.exe` + NAudio,

inst the in-box .NET Framework 4.x |
| Recorder | `bin/LoopbackCap.exe` + NAudio, bundled (424 KB) |
Nothing is installed system-wide.
